mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong household demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST both rising (above 0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets drive wage inflation and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.2% MoM over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (2017 base), it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.3% MoM over any 5-year rolling window.
